Senses.Explanation: A broom remains a concrete sweeping implement, but Chan cases make its handling part of the answer. Shide puts it down and stands with folded hands when asked his name, then picks it up and sweeps when asked again; Yunyan raises his broom when Daowu challenges his sweeping, and later masters replay the gesture and propose replies to it. The Shide case preserves two answering actions with the same object: he puts the broom down and stands when asked his identity, then picks it up and sweeps when the question is repeated. In the Yunyan–Daowu case, Daowu calls sweeping too busy; Yunyan says one should know there is one who is not busy and raises the broom when Daowu asks whether that makes a second moon. Tianyin Yuanxiu replays the case and says that when Yunyan raises the broom he would answer “exactly,” leaving Yunyan nowhere to put it. Other case comments call for a dungpan and broom after an exchange is judged soiled. Xueguan Zhiyin expands the implement into a sermon image—binding empty space into a broom and sweeping buddhas, patriarchs, ordinary and holy—but still calls it a broom held and left behind.

Senses.Note: The verb retains forceful clearing imagery across military, spatial, and Chan-object uses.

Occurrences.Kwic: 行履處。試舉看。【五四】舉。雲門問僧近離甚處僧云。西禪門云。西禪近日有何言句僧展兩手門打一掌僧云。某甲話在門却展兩手僧無語門便打。雲門問這僧。近離甚處。僧云。西禪。這箇是當面話。如閃電相似。門云。近日有何言句。也只是平常說話。這僧也不妨是箇作家。却倒去驗雲門。便展兩手。若是尋常人遭此一驗。便見手忙脚亂。他雲門有石火電光之機。便打一掌。僧云。打即故是。爭奈某甲話在。這僧有轉身處。所以雲門

Senses.Explanation: The comparison makes the matter as sudden and difficult to catch as lightning. Baofu Congzhan says the matter is like lightning, a struck spark, flame, and thunder and tells his hearers they must catch it. Yuanwu Keqin compares Muzhou’s testing action, Xuefeng’s snake image, and Yunmen’s face-to-face exchange to lightning.
